FAQs

How quickly are new job posts added to your dataset?

New postings enter the dataset within the daily refresh — you’ll see new jobs within 24 hours of going live, perfect for spotting growth signals.

Can I segment jobs by multiple criteria at once?

Build exactly the view you need. Combine role types, locations, seniority levels, and company details to zero in on the movements that matter.

How is this better than pulling jobs data from regular job sites?

Regular job boards give you basic listings. Our datasets deliver market intelligence. Track department buildouts, company growth patterns, and market shifts – all connected to company profiles and market trends.

Can I use your datasets to see how competitors are growing?

Our jobs datasets are perfect for competitive intel. See who’s expanding, which roles they’re prioritizing, and where they’re building teams — all updated daily, delivered instantly.

Give your platform an unfair advantage with fresh, compliant B2B data

Your platform deserves better than patched-together datasets and constant cleanup. Get data built to deliver results from day one — and watch your customers win faster.
